vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: kg-note-method-obsidian
Version: 2.27.0

The skill bundle implements a sophisticated 'Knowledge Graph' (KG) methodology for organizing Obsidian note vaults. It directs the agent to categorize notes into specific types (Concept, Object, Skill, Relation) and automate the creation of relationship files and metadata (YAML abstract fields). While the skill utilizes high-risk capabilities such as automated file modification (patching), network searching for image enrichment, and status checking via 'curl -I', these behaviors are explicitly aligned with the stated purpose of note organization. Notably, the instructions include a 'Batch Task List Mechanism' in SKILL.md that requires the agent to generate a checklist and obtain explicit user consent before performing multiple file operations, which serves as a significant safeguard against unauthorized changes.

llm.summary: This Obsidian note-organizing skill is mostly purpose-aligned, but it can automatically create, modify, delete, and cascade changes across many local notes, so users should review it carefully before installing.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the behavior: organizing an Obsidian vault using KG note rules. However, that purpose includes broad local note reading, rewriting, relation-file creation, web searching, and image embedding.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are broad and mandatory, including auto-triggering for Obsidian-related paths/tasks and triggering relationship-building even when a subject note is merely read or modified.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, no executable code, no declared credentials, and the static scan had no code to analyze.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill authorizes create/modify/delete operations in a local Obsidian vault and can expand a single task into many file operations without a consistently required approval step.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill stores task checklists under a _working directory and can resume unfinished tasks in later sessions; this is disclosed and purpose-related, but users should understand that task state persists.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Only install this if you want an agent to reorganize your Obsidian vault, not just read it. Back up the vault first, require confirmations for bulk or destructive edits, review generated relationship files, and disable or approve web search/image embedding when notes contain sensitive information.

evidence.explanation: The skill makes itself mandatory for broad Obsidian activity and says even reading or modifying a subject note should trigger relationship-building, which may exceed a user's narrower intent.
evidence.snippet: “打开任何 Obsidian 笔记前先加载本 skill。” ... “路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 自动触发本 skill” ... “读到/修改任何主体笔记时，立即触发 R0（搜关联→建关系）。 ”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use an explicit opt-in command or confirmation before applying KG organization, and provide a read-only mode for simple note viewing.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A task that only involves opening or inspecting a note could turn into an organizing workflow that changes the vault.

evidence.explanation: The workflow authorizes bulk create/modify/delete operations and some deletion decisions. Only the `kg 检查` flow clearly asks whether to execute, while normal and bulk organization flows can proceed after planning.
evidence.snippet: “任务预期产生 ≥5 个文件操作（新建/修改/删除）时，必须先建清单再动手。” ... “按执行清单步骤逐条执行” ... “无关内容分离 ... 已有更完整→删” ... “补不了才删。”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Require user approval before destructive or bulk changes, show a dry-run diff, limit the vault path, and advise users to back up the Obsidian vault first.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent could alter or delete many notes or note contents if its classification or relationship judgment is wrong.

evidence.explanation: One note operation can propagate into searches, many new relationship files, and pairwise checks across a batch of notes, so one bad inference can spread across the vault.
evidence.snippet: “搜到的每个有效关联必须在步骤⑤建关系，不可跳过。” ... “新建/拆分/读到/修改任何主体笔记时，立即触发 R0” ... “对一批新主体，两两检查是否应有关系线。”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Cap the number of automatically created relationships per run, require confirmation for inferred relationships, and keep a reversible change log.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A mistaken association could create many incorrect relationship notes and require manual cleanup.

evidence.explanation: The skill intentionally persists task state in the vault and later reads it to resume or list unfinished work; this is useful but means task context remains available across sessions.
evidence.snippet: “中途中止 → 清单文件保留，下次会话恢复” ... “search_files target=files, pattern=*完成检查清单*, path=_working/ ... 逐条 read_file 读取。”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Periodically review and clean the `_working` directory, and avoid putting secrets or sensitive details in task checklist names or contents.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Old task plans or note names may be retained and reused later, which could expose private project context inside the vault.

evidence.explanation: The skill may direct the agent to make external web searches and run a `curl` command to check image URLs. This is disclosed and related to note enrichment, but it is extra network/tool activity for an instruction-only skill.
evidence.snippet: “主动搜索网络嵌入” ... “搜索来源：百度图片 / Google Images / Wikipedia” ... “疑似失效的网络图片 → `curl -I` 检查状态码。”

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Ask before web searches or `curl` checks, avoid sending sensitive note text as search queries, and make image embedding optional.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Note topics or image URLs could be sent to external services, and the local environment may execute network requests.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill can auto-trigger broad KG workflows, perform bulk note mutations and deletions, and cascade relationship creation across the vault.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account access, or elevated privileges are declared in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill persists task checklists and reads local vault context, which is expected for note organization but should be managed carefully.
